title: 2018–19 Marathwada drought (Beed)
narrative: Deficient 2018 monsoon over Marathwada; Maharashtra declared drought in 151 talukas on 31 Oct 2018 with Beed among the worst affected.
note: Monthly snapshots are computed on demand (GET /api/drought-index?district=&month=&refresh=true); only the months already stored appear here.
